story.iWant: a data dictionary documenting available analytical query data
story.soThat: ground truth tests align with actual database content and we avoid Epic 2's 12% → 77.6% issue
story.tasks:
**Task 1: Database Inspection (AC1) - 4 hours** - Subtask 1.1: Create inspection script (scripts/inspect-database-for-epic-3.py) - Subtask 1.2: Execute inspection against PostgreSQL financial_tables - Subtask 1.3: Generate JSON catalog (docs/data-dictionary-epic-3.json) - Subtask 1.4: Validate inspection results (cross-check with Epic 2 ground truth)
**Task 2: Create Data Dictionary (AC2) - 2 hours** - Subtask 2.1: Write markdown documentation (docs/data-dictionary-epic-3.md) - Subtask 2.2: Add examples and counts for all metrics, periods, entities - Subtask 2.3: Document validation rules - Subtask 2.4: Test data dictionary completeness (validate against ground_truth.json)
**Task 3: Architecture Review (AC3) - 30 minutes** - Subtask 3.1: Winston reviews dictionary for completeness - Subtask 3.2: Winston approval and Epic 3 test creation unblock

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
**AC1: Database Inspection (4 hours)** Goal: Query database and catalog all available data for analytical queries Success Criteria: - All unique metrics cataloged (EBITDA, Variable Cost, Revenue, etc.) - All unique periods cataloged (Aug-25, Sep-25, YTD variants, etc.) - All unique entities cataloged (Portugal, Tunisia, Angola, Brazil, Group, etc.) - Currency limitations documented (EUR only) - JSON catalog saved: docs/data-dictionary-epic-3.json
**AC2: Create Data Dictionary Document (2 hours)** Goal: Human-readable markdown documentation of available data Success Criteria: - Data dictionary created: docs/data-dictionary-epic-3.md - All sections complete (metrics, periods, entities, currencies, limitations) - Test query validation rules documented - Examples and counts included
**AC3: Winston Architecture Review (30 minutes)** Goal: Verify data dictionary completeness and Epic 3 readiness Success Criteria: - Winston architecture approval documented - Data dictionary approved for Epic 3 test creation - Epic 3 test queries blocked until dictionary validated

doc.title: Epic 3 Prep - Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Data dictionary creation (Day 2 - 6 hours) with database inspection script querying PostgreSQL financial_tables for all unique metrics, periods, entities. Comprehensive markdown documentation with validation rules. Winston architectural review for completeness before Epic 3 test creation.

doc.title: RAGLite - Epic and Story Breakdown
doc.snippet: Enable multi-step reasoning and complex analytical workflows through agentic orchestration. Prep stories (3.0.1-3.0.7) address technical debt reduction including data dictionary creation to prevent ground truth misalignment issues from Epic 2.

doc.title: Epic 2 Retrospective
doc.snippet: Ground truth created from requirements, not database inspection. Queries asked for non-existent data ("Q3 2025" vs "Aug-25 YTD"). Test misalignment caused 12% accuracy (66pp below implementation's actual 77.6%). Action Item 1: Data-first approach - inspect database BEFORE creating test queries.

doc.title: Story 2.14: SQL Generation Edge Case Refinement
doc.snippet: Entity alias mapping: "Group" → "Currency (1000 EUR)", "Angola" → "Secil Angola", "Brazil" → "Adrianopolis" OR "Pomerode". Implemented in query_classifier.py using fuzzy string matching with 80% threshold.

doc.title: Story 2.15: Ground Truth Normalization Epic 2 Final Validation
doc.snippet: Period mappings: Q3 2025 → [Jul-25, Aug-25, Sep-25, Aug-25 YTD], Q2 2025 → [Apr-25, May-25, Jun-25, Jun-25 YTD]. Implemented in period_normalizer.py to handle quarter-to-month conversions for database queries.

doc.title: Story 3.0.1: Refactor Modules to Size Limits (Previous Story)
doc.snippet: 9 new focused modules created from 2 oversized files. Database client location confirmed: raglite.shared.clients.get_db_client(). No import path changes affecting database access patterns. Clean module structure unblocks Epic 3 development.

doc.title: Ground Truth Test Set
doc.snippet: 50+ question-answer pairs for accuracy validation. Contains queries referencing metrics (EBITDA, Revenue), periods (Q3 2025, Aug-25), entities (Portugal, Tunisia). Critical reference for validating data dictionary completeness (AC2 Subtask 2.4).

story-context.constraints:
**KISS Principle Compliance:** - NO new dependencies (use existing asyncpg client from Story 2.6) - Simple SELECT DISTINCT queries only (no ORMs, no query builders, no aggregations) - NO custom data catalog frameworks (markdown + JSON sufficient) - Direct SQL queries via existing get_db_client() helper
**Database Access Pattern:** - Use get_db_client() from raglite.shared.clients for PostgreSQL access - Follow async pattern: async def inspect_database() - Query financial_tables schema with standard SELECT DISTINCT queries - No complex joins or aggregations required
**Data Dictionary Format:** - Markdown tables for human readability (version-controlled in docs/) - JSON catalog (optional) for programmatic access by test scripts - Standard structure: Metrics → Periods → Entities → Currencies → Limitations
**Module Boundaries (from Story 3.0.1):** - Database clients in: raglite.shared.clients (use existing, don't modify) - Inspection script standalone: scripts/inspect-database-for-epic-3.py - No new abstractions or wrappers around database access
**Testing Requirements:** - Cross-validation with Epic 2 ground truth (Subtask 1.4) - Completeness testing against ground_truth.json (Subtask 2.4) - Integration test already exists: tests/integration/test_inspect_database_epic_3_integration.py
**Documentation Standards:** - Test query validation rules documented in dictionary - Period mappings from Story 2.15 included - Entity aliases from Story 2.14 included - Limitations explicitly stated (no hidden assumptions)

interface.name: get_db_client()
interface.description: Returns PostgreSQL database client using asyncpg. Primary interface for all database queries. Established in Story 2.6, confirmed available after Story 3.0.1 refactoring.

interface.name: financial_tables
interface.signature: Table: financial_tables Columns: metric (TEXT), period (TEXT), entity (TEXT), currency (TEXT), value (NUMERIC) Rows: 170,142
interface.description: PostgreSQL table containing all financial data. Source for data dictionary inspection. Query with SELECT DISTINCT to catalog unique values.

interface.name: Data Dictionary Output Format
interface.signature: Markdown: docs/data-dictionary-epic-3.md (human-readable tables) JSON: docs/data-dictionary-epic-3.json (programmatic access, optional)
interface.description: Output format specification. Markdown for developers/testers, JSON for test scripts. Both version-controlled in docs/ directory.
